question: What is the ruling on: the ticket owns the refusal surviving conformers?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answer:
RULED: the boat is owned by the ticket. the gate is the refuser but it's doing so on behalf of the ticket. so the ticket owns the refusal. it's a peer system (original ruling 2026-08-10, confirmed by Akien)
supersede them, same principle, surviving conformers (Akien, 2026-08-30 — harbor_master device was removed; the principle holds, the conformer set shrank)
